_meta.name: SX7 Sexual Seven — Clean Confirmation
_meta.description: Sexual Seven. HIGH confidence. Stage 1 canonical rankings: Head center dominant (18/12/6), SX instinct dominant (18/12/6). No counter-type flag. Stage 2 cross-reference cleanly confirms Type 7 (Assertive/Positive/Frustration). Stage 3 Standard mode resolves to Type 7. Stage 4 Option A confirms cleanly. No counter-type, no type confusion. Section 1A and Section 6A should NOT appear.

stage0.q1: enthusiastic, curious, always chasing what's interesting — I love deep conversations and exploring ideas with people I find genuinely fascinating
stage0.q2: fun, energetic, a bit scattered, good at starting things and inspiring others but not always at following through
stage0.q3: seeing possibilities everywhere and getting the people I care about excited about them
stage0.q4: I avoid discomfort and difficult emotions — I reframe or escape rather than sitting with what's hard

stage2.ambiguityAxis: All three Stage 2 frameworks land on Type 7's signature: Assertive (Hornevian), Positive (Harmonic), Frustration (Object Relations). Types 5 and 6 do not overlap on any framework — clean Type 7 cross-reference confirmation.

stage4.stressDescription: Picked the canonical Type 7 answer — under stress the client moves toward Type 1 territory, becoming more critical, perfectionistic, and rigid, losing their usual flexibility and optimism. This matched Type 7's stress point cleanly.
stage4.securityDescription: Picked the canonical Type 7 answer — in ease the client moves toward Type 5, becoming more focused, quiet, and capable of sustained depth when feeling safe, able to stay with one thing rather than jumping to the next. This matched Type 7's security point cleanly.
